FILE: app/models/user.rb
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

class User < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :sessions
end
```

FILE: app/services/user_creator.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

class UserCreator
  def call(params)
    User.create(params)
  end
end

PR_BODY_START
## What this does

Mixes a fenced block and a plain block in the same response.
